summary: Verified iteration-4 follow-ups. All 4 backend suites pass (43/43) after I fixed stale test scripts: test_followup_fixes.py (new) 5/5, test_olam_api.py 20/20, test_csv_export_control.py 9/9, test_security_fixes.py 9/9. UI checks pass: 375px coordinator header with a long name truncates with an ellipsis and both 'Password' and 'Sign out' are fully visible (44px tall); QA admin lands on the dashboard; the owner is forced to /staff/change-password, even when opening /staff/dashboard directly; scanner manual check shows VALID and then ALREADY CHECKED IN. CRITICAL FINDING: header spoofing is blocked, but only because _client_ip takes the LAST X-Forwarded-For entry, which is the shared Google load balancer IP (34.111.104.211) for every client. As a result every IP-based limit and the login lockout is shared by all users, and the lockout-abuse fix does not work in this environment.

critical.issue: Ingress sends no X-Real-IP (any client-sent X-Real-IP is stripped). Observed X-Forwarded-For: '<client-supplied>,35.193.209.116(real client),172.70.x.x/108.162.x.x(Cloudflare edge, varies per request),34.111.104.211(Google LB, constant)'. xff[-1] is therefore the same LB IP for every user, so all rate-limit buckets are global: registrations 10/min, lookup 15/min and verify 30/min across ALL students, and login 20/min across all staff. The (email+IP) lockout reduces to per-email, so anyone anywhere can lock the owner out with 5 wrong passwords. Lockout-abuse fix NOT effective. Spoof resistance holds, but only because every client collapses into one bucket.

minor.issue: The per-email failure list (_login_fails[email]) is not cleared on a successful login, and the in-memory dicts _rl_hits/_login_fails grow without bound (stale keys are never removed).

issues: The 'OLAM 3.0 • COORDINATOR' eyebrow wraps onto 2 lines when the header actions are present (cosmetic)
The 'Password' / 'Sign out' text is light grey on white, which is borderline contrast

action_items: HIGH: Fix _client_ip so it picks the real client and not the shared Google LB IP. In this preview the real client is xff[-3] (client, Cloudflare edge, Google LB). Make the number of trusted proxy hops configurable, e.g. TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=2 -> ip = xff[-(hops+1)] when len(xff) > hops, else xff[0]. Do NOT trust left-most entries or a client-sent X-Real-IP. Production topology may differ: log the X-Forwarded-For seen in production once and confirm the hop count.
After the fix, re-run test_followup_fixes.py. Spoofed XFF/X-Real-IP must still give 429 by request 16, and two different real IPs must get independent buckets.
Optional: remove stale keys from _rl_hits/_login_fails periodically (memory growth).

rca_of_issue: Repro: temporarily logged headers in _client_ip and sent requests through the external URL. x-real-ip=None even when the client sent one. x-forwarded-for='5.6.7.8(spoof),35.193.209.116,172.70.126.106,34.111.104.211' and on the next request '35.193.209.116,108.162.216.201,34.111.104.211'. The last entry is constant (the GCP LB), so every client maps to the same key. Mitigation: index from the right, skipping the trusted proxy hops (2 here).
